    EVERYONE. CONNECTED

    Connectivity powers our lives, strengthens communities and drives progress. When everyone is connected, we can create a future full of possibilities.

    Our Purpose
    Main Content

    people. connected

    We connect people to opportunity

    Our next-generation mobile and broadband networks empower consumers and communities, enabling them to thrive in a fast-paced world. And our passion for innovation helps people everywhere unlock their potential.

    EXPLORE CONNECTING PEOPLE EXPLORE CONNECTING PEOPLE

    279 m

    mobile customers

    people. connected

    people.connected

    15

    Country markets

    40+

    Partner markets

    Innovating Europe

    As a new age of connectivity dawns in Europe, we're setting the pace as one of the continent's largest providers. Our next gen services are enriching people's lives and ensuring everyone benefits from digital transformation fairly and safely.

    Link to AI improving customer net promoter score by 20% across Europe

    AI improving customer net promoter score by 20% across Europe

    Empowering Africa

    We're spreading digital inclusion across this fast-growing continent. Through Vodapay and M-PESA, we lead our African markets with groundbreaking connectivity, financial, business and merchant services. 

    Link to Bringing connection to rural areas in Africa increasing growth in the market

    Bringing connection to rural areas in Africa increasing growth in the market

    Connecting people

    businesses. connected

    We connect businesses to their potential

    Businesses need bold ideas. Our trailblazing solutions – from connectivity to security and cloud – drive transformation for organisations of all sizes.

    EXPLORE CONNECTING BUSINESSES EXPLORE CONNECTING BUSINESSES

    5 m

    Empowered business customers

    businesses. connected

    businesses.connected

    Powering growth in a digital world

    No matter the size of your business, our technology can help you progress and thrive. With our expertise in connectivity, our leading IoT platform and our global scale, we're taking customers to bold new heights, unlocking transformative value.

    215M+

    IoT connections

    215M+

    IoT connections

    Perky Blenders: Brewing digital transformation

    Transforming businesses

    Learn more
    Connecting businesses

    continents. connected

    We bring countries closer

    We believe global connectivity powers progress. Our world-leading subsea cables and satellite technology bring people and businesses closer than ever, fuelling opportunities and bridging digital divides.

    EXPLORE CONNECTING CONTINENTS EXPLORE CONNECTING CONTINENTS

    70

    subsea cables invested in or co-owned

    continents. connected

    continents.connected

    Deep connections

    Subsea cable systems are an invisible engine driving digital economies. We have over 80 of them joining 100 countries, and we’ll add more as needed  to support ever-growing demand. 

    What are subsea cables?

    Expanding our reach

    From the remotest places to mid-ocean vessels, our satellite solutions are filling previously unreachable connectivity gaps.

    What are space-based communications?

    Connecting continents

    futures. connected

    Unlimited possibilities await

    Invention shapes progress and resilience. By exploring revolutionary tools like AI and quantum computing, we're redefining what's possible and building sustainable growth for years to come.

    EXPLORE CONNECTING FUTURES EXPLORE CONNECTING FUTURES

    Unlimited

    Future possibilities

    futures. connected

    futures.connected

    Innovation for a connected future

    Technology plus imagination equals extraordinary results. From training heart surgeons with augmented reality to IoT tools that deliver the finest Wimbledon strawberries, our potential to innovate is endless.
